tramaj — a small template language for turning a JSON value into a document tree.

Overview: https://lucasdicioccio.github.io/tramaj/
For coding agents: https://lucasdicioccio.github.io/tramaj/howto-agents.html
Getting started (humans): https://lucasdicioccio.github.io/tramaj/howto-humans.html
Properties: https://lucasdicioccio.github.io/tramaj/properties.html
Use cases: https://lucasdicioccio.github.io/tramaj/use-cases.html
Interactive playground: https://lucasdicioccio.github.io/tramaj/playground.html

Specs (canonical source, on GitHub):
- Language reference: https://github.com/lucasdicioccio/tramaj/blob/main/specs/reference.md
- Node JSON representation: https://github.com/lucasdicioccio/tramaj/blob/main/specs/node-json.md
- v3, symbolic values and constraints: https://github.com/lucasdicioccio/tramaj/blob/main/specs/v3-symbols.md
- v4, types: https://github.com/lucasdicioccio/tramaj/blob/main/specs/v4-types.md
- Design laws: https://github.com/lucasdicioccio/tramaj/blob/main/specs/laws.md
- Design decisions log: https://github.com/lucasdicioccio/tramaj/blob/main/specs/decisions.md

Conformance corpus (runnable examples): https://github.com/lucasdicioccio/tramaj/tree/main/corpus/cases

Every article on this site is also served as plain text, at
/text/<page-name>.cmark.text (e.g. /text/reference-language.cmark.text) —
fetch that instead of the HTML when you only need the content.
